newsitem.title: UK: Iceland to take on 1,000 new full time staff.
newsitem.headline: Iceland to take on 1,000 new full time staff.

text.p: Iceland Frozen Foods Plc said on Thursday it was taking on 1,000 additional full time staff for its new free home delivery service.

Iceland will offer shoppers spending more than 25 stg free delivery within a ten mile radius of every store. The service will be available in all 770 Iceland outlets by the end of September, after successful trials in Scotland, Tyne Tees, in the north east of England, Portsmouth in the south and Chester in the north west.
The service promises to deliver shopping on the day of purchase, within a two hour period of the customers' choice and in refrigerated vans.
Chairman and chief executive Malcolm Walker said that with more than 60 percent of the UK population dependent on public transport the attraction of free home delivery was enormous.
"Now people can shop in their lunch hour and have the goods delivered after they arrive home."
